subject: general
question: Shamita's birthday was on 15 March 2020, which was a Sunday. If her husband's birthday was on 31 May 2020, on which day would it fall?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• Shamita's birthday was on 15 March 2020 and it was a Sunday.
 
• Her husband's birthday was on 31 May 2020.
 
• No of days from 15 March 2020 to 31 May 2020 = 16(days in March) + 30(April) + 31(May) = 77.
 
• Since it was Sunday on 15 March 2020, every 7th day from 15 March will be a Sunday.
 
• Thus, no. of odd days = 77/7 = 0

 
• Therefore, 31st May 2020 will be Sunday.

Hence,** "option 2"** is the correct answer.
